question_text: If elections were held today, who would you vote for as the next President?

methodology.disclosure_note: TUKO reported on 25 September 2026 that Mizani Africa did not disclose the methodology, sample size or margin of error for the presidential-preference survey. A companion opposition-flagbearer release was reported as conducted 3–11 September 2026, but those dates are not assumed for this question.

notes: Candidate percentages are preserved as a published, source-transparent observation. Capital FM and TUKO independently corroborate the headline presidential figures; however, core methodology remains undisclosed. The record is therefore public-display eligible but excluded from aggregate polling averages until methodology is verified.
